text.description: Caption / message content delivered to the user via glass/chat. Required and must be non-empty even when attachments are present.

user_id.description: Recipient user id (defaults to active wake user or operator)

attachment_ids.description: Host attachment ids already registered (prior upload or media/). Re-send clones a new att_id pointing at the same blob sha.

attachments.description: Optional declare-by-sandbox-path (host copies into media store and projects RO media/).

kind.description: Optional kind override: image | audio | video | file
